Oppia




Oppia is an open-source online learning platform that enables anyone to create and share interactive learning experiences called explorations. These explorations simulate a one-on-one conversation with a tutor, allowing learners to learn by doing and receive immediate feedback.

Oppia focuses on providing free, high-quality education to learners who lack access to traditional educational resources.

🌍 Live site: https://www.oppia.org

✨ What Oppia Offers

📘 Interactive, conversation-based learning

🧠 Personalized feedback for learners

🌱 Free lessons in basic mathematics

🔬 Expanding into science and financial literacy

🌐 Built and maintained by a global open-source community

Check out our live lessons here:
👉 https://www.oppia.org/fractions

🛠️ Tech Stack

Oppia is built using:

Backend: Python

Frontend: Angular

Infrastructure: Google App Engine

CI/CD: GitHub Actions
